# Titanix

> Titanix is a product studio (est. 2021) that designs and ships iOS apps, SaaS platforms, and IoT systems — from bare metal and embedded firmware to the App Store and cloud. Website: https://www.titanix.dev

## People

- **Menan Sali**, co-founder. Computer Science graduate (South East European University); builds native iOS apps and their backends, and RF/IoT systems. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/menansali/ · GitHub: https://github.com/menansali

## What we do

- **iOS Apps** — Native iOS applications in Swift & SwiftUI: on-device and cloud AI, WidgetKit, Live Activities, StoreKit subscriptions, full App Store launches.
- **SaaS Platforms** — End-to-end web products: auth, billing, multi-tenant dashboards, APIs, real-time data. Typical stack: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Stripe.
- **IoT Systems** — Hardware + software: embedded firmware, LoRa/edge networks, sensor data pipelines, live telemetry.

## Shipped products

- **Lovly** (iOS, Lifestyle/Social) — couples app with a shared drawing canvas, moods and love notes on each partner's Lock Screen. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/lovly — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760272304
- **Memopix** (iOS, Photo & Video) — turns 20-60 photos into shaped photo-collage keepsakes across 34 templates, print-ready as PNG, JPEG or PDF. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/memopix — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789686385
- **Qaza Qada: Missed Salah** (iOS, Lifestyle) — estimates missed prayers, builds a make-up plan, and keeps the remaining count on the Lock Screen; also daily verses, offline prayer times, Qibla and Tasbih. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/qaza-qada — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757791803
- **Aer: Air Quality** (iOS, Weather/Health) — live AQI for 35 cities in North Macedonia with a 7-day Copernicus (CAMS) forecast, alerts and widgets. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/aer — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790945433
- **Pet Portraits** (iOS, AI) — turns one dog or cat photo into gallery-grade AI portraits and animated Living Portraits. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/pet-portraits — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6793742748
- **skeniraj.mk** (SaaS, Hospitality) — QR-menu platform for restaurants and hotels with a multi-tenant dashboard and billing. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/skeniraj — Live: https://skeniraj.mk

## IoT lab work

- **Env Monitor Pro** — indoor/outdoor particulate (PM1/PM2.5/PM10) and humidity monitoring on Raspberry Pi with an OPC-N3 sensor and Grafana dashboards.
- **Edge LoRa Network** — low-power long-range sensor network on LilyGO T-Beam and Arduino Nano 33 BLE nodes.

## Notes

- How the background of this site works (WebGL contour shader): https://www.titanix.dev/notes/how-the-background-of-this-site-works

## Offers (iOS)

- **App Launch Audit** (48 hours) — an app that is built or nearly built is put through the Titanix pre-submission check and launch review: App Review risks (privacy, permissions, subscriptions, sign-in, account deletion), paywall and pricing, App Store listing, leaked keys, crash risks and analytics. Result: a READY / NOT READY report with the fix for each problem. Fixed price.
- **Idea to App Store** (fixed scope) — the full process from idea check to a live, monetized native iOS app. Guarantee: if App Review rejects the app Titanix built, it is fixed and resubmitted at no extra cost until approved. Fixed price.
- Process and details: https://www.titanix.dev/ship (order the audit without a call: https://www.titanix.dev/ship#order)

## App Review rejection guides

Plain-English guides to the App Store Review Guidelines that reject apps most often, with causes, fixes and what to tell App Review: https://www.titanix.dev/app-review

## How we work

Discover (scope the v1) → Build the MVP (weekly working builds) → Launch (App Store review, listing, analytics, payments, deploy) → Grow (iterate on real usage). Engagements: fixed-scope MVP or an ongoing monthly partnership.
